title: Why Russia Wants a Russia–India–China Alliance Again?

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston...
Russia ek khatarnaak khel khelne ja raha hai.
Ek aisa khel... jo seedhe America ki superpower position ko open challenge deta hai.
Aur agar yeh plan kaamyaab ho gaya...
Toh duniya ek baar phir... naye Cold War ke andheron mein chali jaayegi!
Lekin sabse badi tension ki baat yeh hai— Is baar pressure kisi Ukraine ya Syria par nahi...balki Seedha Bharat par hoga.
Kyuki is baar Russia chahata hai… 
ki Bharat, America ko chhodkar...
China aur Russia ke saath milkar ek nayi alliance banaye.
Aur zara sochiye...
Ye teen desh milkar...
duniya ka 22% GDP aur 36% population represent karte hain.
Toh agar ye alliance ban gaya...
toh yeh duniya ki sabse powerful alliances mein se ek ban sakti hai.
Lekin...
agar Bharat ne is baar Russia ka saath de diya...
Toh Donald Trump jaise aggressive leaders...
Bharat ko puri tarah hila kar rakh sakte hain.
Toh sawaal uthta hai—
Aakhir Russia yeh alliance banana kyun chahta hai?
Kya Bharat, Russia aur China ke saath milkar America ko challenge kar payega?
Aur is alliance se Bharat par kya impact pad sakta hai?
